I withdrew the finding: the repository does have a generic register test that covers the regwen locking item.

The common CSR test plan maps `regwen_csr_and_corresponding_lockable_csr` to the shared `csr_rw` and `csr_aliasing` tests. The register model (`lock_lockable_flds` in `hw/dv/sv/dv_base_reg/dv_base_reg.sv`) makes lockable fields read-only once regwen is cleared. `csr_rw`'s read-back would therefore fail if a lockable CSR stayed writable.

I did not identify which block the finding refers to. I only confirmed `csr_rw` is referenced in the aes and kmac environments, and found no match for hmac. The test plan itself says a HW-updated regwen would still need a separate test, and I did not check whether any block here has one.

The verdict has been accepted, so there is nothing further to do.
